'''Garen''' was a member of a Republic [[class-seven retrieval team]] capable of handling [[ZR-57 orbital strike bomb]]s. After one such bomb was almost set off on [[Voss]], Garen and [[Jak (technician)|Jak]] were brought in to safely retrieve it.
